writeup: TIC 467962259 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 4.0616 days. The system shows a primary eclipse causing 3.89% dimming, along with a secondary eclipse detected at 5.0 sigma significance near orbital phase 0.49. Automated analysis of TESS photometry yielded a strong detection signal with a BLS signal-to-noise ratio of 48.2. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal's location through difference imaging, detecting a peak signal-to-noise of 17.2, though with a centroid offset of 5.1 arcsec from the target position. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a potentially novel target. The pipeline's machine learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.32, reflecting moderate confidence in the classification. The candidate passed all automated data quality checks without flags.
